caption: The drawing features a large metal hook connected to two oval-shaped metal rings, one at the top and one at the bottom. The hook is attached to the upper ring via a coiled metal loop, and the bottom ring is inserted through a hole at the end of the hook. The background is a plain, light beige with some faint spots and areas of discoloration, and there are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Anchor Trip Hook
